design.purpose: Warm 62 cm cowl for one adult, 60 g per colour

steps.c: Place yarn, hook and scissors on table.
Ch 40, sl st to join ring.
Join blue, carry green. Rnd 5-8: ch 2, 40 hdc, join.
Join green, carry blue. Rnd 9-11: ch 2, 40 hdc, join.
Join blue, carry green. Rnd 12-14: ch 2, 40 hdc, fasten off.
